layout_finding.classification: confirmed harness container selection error before Select All
layout_finding.finding: Generic helper selected the hittable keyboard candidate collection rather than pdfAssembly.form. Target cannot fit inside that 45pt collection. Video also shows keyboard accessory above the Keyboard AX frame.
layout_finding.fix: Use exact assembly Form and exclude its keyboard accessory, retaining full visibility/hittability and bounded native scroll. Existing Select All replacement and all later assertions retained.

limitations: No automatic picker fallback, re-selection, timeout increase, skipped assertion or injected file/binding.
SwiftUI baseline does not expose native created/dismantled callbacks; public observed mode and App completion events are recorded.
Original open failures remain failures independently of the new explicit copy option.
conclusions: SE and Large each executed and failed the one baseline case after one real callback and reading the two-page PDF; both failed before Select All. Exact Large Session geometry proves generic helper selected keyboard candidate collection.

Current SwiftUI and UIKit-open each executed and failed the one selected case because no real importer callback arrived after native Open. UIKit creation and observation had a delegate. No basis to attribute this only to SwiftUI or to prove an OS defect.
Exact17 boot succeeded but zero methods executed; summary contains one synthetic bootstrap failure, not a failed assembly method. Runner sample waited for XCTest configuration/IDE session.
Explicit copy product route and exact-Form harness fix are frozen for new CI; none of these old failures is accepted or replaced by a copy result.
